title: Senior's toolkit: flake hunting
summary: Repeat a test until it breaks, replay an order with a seed, collect hang and crash dumps, and quarantine honestly with traits and visible retries.

steps.title: Senior's toolkit: flake hunting
steps.body: The commands for turning "it fails sometimes" into a failure you can watch.

toolkit.cmd: for i in $(seq 200); do dotnet test --project Shop.Tests --no-build --filter-method "*Writes_csv*" || break; done
toolkit.what: Repeat one test until it fails (bash). Build once, then `--no-build` keeps each run fast.
flags: skip the build on every iteration
stop at the first failure, with its output on screen
toolkit.example:
dotnet build Shop.Tests
for i in $(seq 200); do dotnet test --project Shop.Tests --no-build --filter-method "*Writes_csv*" || break; done

toolkit.what: MTP hang-dump extension (Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.HangDump): when a test runs longer than the timeout, write a dump and the hanging test's name, then kill the run.
flags: how long before it counts as hung
a dump when the test process crashes (Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CrashDump)

toolkit.what: xUnit v3 randomises with a seed and prints it; pass the seed back to replay exactly the order that failed.
flags: run test cases in parallel: shakes out shared state
see ITestOutputHelper lines as tests run

toolkit.what: MTP retry extension (Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.Retry): re-run failed tests. Only as a temporary, visible quarantine: the report still shows which tests needed a retry.
flags: mark a known flaky test with its ticket
keep it out of the blocking job until fixed

steps.prompt: Match the situation to the command.
pairs: the CI job times out after 60 minutes with no failing test named
a failure only happened in one random order
a test fails one run in fifty
a known flaky test must not block releases while it is being fixed
a Quarantine trait with its ticket, filtered out

steps.prompt: A test needs a retry about once a week. The team quarantines it with a trait and a ticket. What makes this acceptable rather than hiding the problem?
options: The quarantine is visible (trait plus ticket), time-boxed, and the quarantined tests still run and are reported in a non-blocking job
Quarantined tests are deleted after a week
Nobody needs to look at it as long as CI is green
steps.explain: Quarantine keeps the main build trustworthy while someone fixes the cause. Without an owner and a deadline it is just deletion with extra steps.
